Indexed callers: House interiors · area $51, object $02
Dialogue elsewhere in this event (association only, not proof of meaning):
Excuse me, are you Otto?

Later, later...

My daughter Norma went to the Tower up north using my Rainbow Road.

But the powerful wind from Mt. Gale broke the road-making machine.

Norma's stuck there until the winds die down.

[Hero name], let's keep on going.
The Crystal of Wind might be in that mountain.

Promise me you'll stop that wind!

The wind has suddenly stopped.
I'll try to make the Rainbow Road!


It worked!

Otto, we're going to save Norma and the Crystal!

Wait!

In the Tower, you'll see switches on even-numbered floors.  Flick the switches with your Axe.

Then the elevator won't go past that floor!

Please bring my daughter back!

The wind won't stop until you save the Crystal of Wind!

We still have Captain Mac to worry about.
Spencer said you'd help...

Reuben!
Are you okay?

Yeah!
And guess what I found when I fell?

A stairway to the top of the Focus Tower!

Stairway?!

I've got it!
If we refill the dry lake, we can save Captain Mac!

How?

Go to Spencer's tunnel.

Set a bomb there, and the water from the Upper Lake will spill into the dry lake!

But Spencer's tunnel has caved in.

There is one way...

If you power the Rainbow Road Machine with Thunder Rock, you can reach Spencer's Place!

Dad will know about this!

Kaeli, would you take care of Norma?

Reuben and I know the Focus Tower well, so we'll be back from Fireburg in no time.

Of course.

Reuben, keep your eyes on the Rope Bridge, and say hello to Arion!

Found some Thunder Rock, huh?


Power up completed!
Now you can go to Spencer's Place!

Thanks to you the lake is as beautiful as ever!

evidence.context:
Indexed callers: House interiors · area $51, object $02
Dialogue elsewhere in this event (association only, not proof of meaning):
Excuse me, are you Otto?

Later, later...

My daughter Norma went to the Tower up north using my Rainbow Road.

But the powerful wind from Mt. Gale broke the road-making machine.

Norma's stuck there until the winds die down.

[Hero name], let's keep on going.
The Crystal of Wind might be in that mountain.

Promise me you'll stop that wind!

The wind has suddenly stopped.
I'll try to make the Rainbow Road!


It worked!

Otto, we're going to save Norma and the Crystal!

Wait!

In the Tower, you'll see switches on even-numbered floors.  Flick the switches with your Axe.

Then the elevator won't go past that floor!

Please bring my daughter back!

The wind won't stop until you save the Crystal of Wind!

We still have Captain Mac to worry about.
Spencer said you'd help...

Reuben!
Are you okay?

Yeah!
And guess what I found when I fell?

A stairway to the top of the Focus Tower!

Stairway?!

I've got it!
If we refill the dry lake, we can save Captain Mac!

How?

Go to Spencer's tunnel.

Set a bomb there, and the water from the Upper Lake will spill into the dry lake!

But Spencer's tunnel has caved in.

There is one way...

If you power the Rainbow Road Machine with Thunder Rock, you can reach Spencer's Place!

Dad will know about this!

Kaeli, would you take care of Norma?

Reuben and I know the Focus Tower well, so we'll be back from Fireburg in no time.

Of course.

Reuben, keep your eyes on the Rope Bridge, and say hello to Arion!

Found some Thunder Rock, huh?


Power up completed!
Now you can go to Spencer's Place!

Thanks to you the lake is as beautiful as ever!

Indexed callers: House interiors · area $51, object $02
Dialogue elsewhere in this event (association only, not proof of meaning):
Excuse me, are you Otto?

Later, later...

My daughter Norma went to the Tower up north using my Rainbow Road.

But the powerful wind from Mt. Gale broke the road-making machine.

Norma's stuck there until the winds die down.

[Hero name], let's keep on going.
The Crystal of Wind might be in that mountain.

Promise me you'll stop that wind!

The wind has suddenly stopped.
I'll try to make the Rainbow Road!


It worked!

Otto, we're going to save Norma and the Crystal!

Wait!

In the Tower, you'll see switches on even-numbered floors.  Flick the switches with your Axe.

Then the elevator won't go past that floor!

Please bring my daughter back!

The wind won't stop until you save the Crystal of Wind!

We still have Captain Mac to worry about.
Spencer said you'd help...

Reuben!
Are you okay?

Yeah!
And guess what I found when I fell?

A stairway to the top of the Focus Tower!

Stairway?!

I've got it!
If we refill the dry lake, we can save Captain Mac!

How?

Go to Spencer's tunnel.

Set a bomb there, and the water from the Upper Lake will spill into the dry lake!

But Spencer's tunnel has caved in.

There is one way...

If you power the Rainbow Road Machine with Thunder Rock, you can reach Spencer's Place!

Dad will know about this!

Kaeli, would you take care of Norma?

Reuben and I know the Focus Tower well, so we'll be back from Fireburg in no time.

Of course.

Reuben, keep your eyes on the Rope Bridge, and say hello to Arion!

Found some Thunder Rock, huh?


Power up completed!
Now you can go to Spencer's Place!

Thanks to you the lake is as beautiful as ever!

Indexed callers: House interiors · area $51, object $02
Dialogue elsewhere in this event (association only, not proof of meaning):
Excuse me, are you Otto?

Later, later...

My daughter Norma went to the Tower up north using my Rainbow Road.

But the powerful wind from Mt. Gale broke the road-making machine.

Norma's stuck there until the winds die down.

[Hero name], let's keep on going.
The Crystal of Wind might be in that mountain.

Promise me you'll stop that wind!

The wind has suddenly stopped.
I'll try to make the Rainbow Road!


It worked!

Otto, we're going to save Norma and the Crystal!

Wait!

In the Tower, you'll see switches on even-numbered floors.  Flick the switches with your Axe.

Then the elevator won't go past that floor!

Please bring my daughter back!

The wind won't stop until you save the Crystal of Wind!

We still have Captain Mac to worry about.
Spencer said you'd help...

Reuben!
Are you okay?

Yeah!
And guess what I found when I fell?

A stairway to the top of the Focus Tower!

Stairway?!

I've got it!
If we refill the dry lake, we can save Captain Mac!

How?

Go to Spencer's tunnel.

Set a bomb there, and the water from the Upper Lake will spill into the dry lake!

But Spencer's tunnel has caved in.

There is one way...

If you power the Rainbow Road Machine with Thunder Rock, you can reach Spencer's Place!

Dad will know about this!

Kaeli, would you take care of Norma?

Reuben and I know the Focus Tower well, so we'll be back from Fireburg in no time.

Of course.

Reuben, keep your eyes on the Rope Bridge, and say hello to Arion!

Found some Thunder Rock, huh?


Power up completed!
Now you can go to Spencer's Place!

Thanks to you the lake is as beautiful as ever!

Excuse me, are you Otto?

Later, later...

My daughter Norma went to the Tower up north using my Rainbow Road.

Set a bomb there, and the water from the Upper Lake will spill into the dry lake!

But Spencer's tunnel has caved in.

There is one way...

If you power the Rainbow Road Machine with Thunder Rock, you can reach Spencer's Place!

Dad will know about this!

Kaeli, would you take care of Norma?

Reuben and I know the Focus Tower well, so we'll be back from Fireburg in no time.

Of course.

Reuben, keep your eyes on the Rope Bridge, and say hello to Arion!

Found some Thunder Rock, huh?


Power up completed!
Now you can go to Spencer's Place!

Thanks to you the lake is as beautiful as ever!

Dialogue elsewhere in this event (association only, not proof of meaning):
Excuse me, are you Otto?

Later, later...

My daughter Norma went to the Tower up north using my Rainbow Road.

But the powerful wind from Mt. Gale broke the road-making machine.

Norma's stuck there until the winds die down.

[Hero name], let's keep on going.
The Crystal of Wind might be in that mountain.

Promise me you'll stop that wind!

The wind has suddenly stopped.
I'll try to make the Rainbow Road!


It worked!

Otto, we're going to save Norma and the Crystal!

Wait!

In the Tower, you'll see switches on even-numbered floors.  Flick the switches with your Axe.

Then the elevator won't go past that floor!

Please bring my daughter back!

The wind won't stop until you save the Crystal of Wind!

We still have Captain Mac to worry about.
Spencer said you'd help...

Reuben!
Are you okay?

Yeah!
And guess what I found when I fell?

A stairway to the top of the Focus Tower!

Stairway?!

I've got it!
If we refill the dry lake, we can save Captain Mac!

How?

Go to Spencer's tunnel.

Set a bomb there, and the water from the Upper Lake will spill into the dry lake!

But Spencer's tunnel has caved in.

There is one way...

If you power the Rainbow Road Machine with Thunder Rock, you can reach Spencer's Place!

Dad will know about this!

Kaeli, would you take care of Norma?

Reuben and I know the Focus Tower well, so we'll be back from Fireburg in no time.

Of course.

Reuben, keep your eyes on the Rope Bridge, and say hello to Arion!

Found some Thunder Rock, huh?


Power up completed!
Now you can go to Spencer's Place!

Thanks to you the lake is as beautiful as ever!

Dark[06]King, we meet at last...

Indeed, and now you will serve me...

I don't think so!
We won't allow you to ruin our World.

Alas, silly humans, I must share a terrible secret!

That Prophecy?
Ages ago I started that rumor!

Welcome to the power of Darkness!

Yes, yes!!
We defeated the Dark[06]King!

At last!
It's all over!

Diguised as a human I, the Crystal of Light, have guided you.

Evil can't thrive if you keep hope alive, use your courage, and respect your World.
A bright future awaits you now.
Go, and enjoy all the World has to offer.

Thank you!

[Hero name]!
You say the Dark[06]King was the problem, and you beat him?!

But of course!
Say, what's become of Reuben and Captain Mac?

They're fine!
They've already headed home.

Great.  Sometime I'll drop by and say “Hi!”

You're safe!

What are you going to do now?

Hey, maybe you can answer that.
Mac, how about lending me that ship?
I need a little more adventure in my life...

Don't worry, Kaeli!

Alright.
But let me see if it's still seaworthy.

Don't forget your Cap again!

Spencer!
You still digging?

Yep.  All because of you guys!

Anybody seen Tristam?

That jerk... He's gone treasure hunting again!

Well, tell him I said ”Hi.”

How's it going?

Reuben!  Couldn't be better!

Why don't we hang out in this town?

No way!
I'm off for more adventure in Captain Mac's ship.

At least let me see you off!

The ship's better than new!

Thanks, Mac.

Three cheers for Captain [Hero name]!

Wait until you see my next invention!

Can you come over again?

Have a good trip!

Do it up while you're young!

I think I've had all the adventure I can stand!

How about taking me along?
You'll need an expert treasure hunter!

You don't know what you're saying, Grandpa!

You'll be back in no time.
See the World for me!

We're going to miss you.

I'm going to miss you, too.

Farewell!

What are you doing here?

I can't resist it when I hear about an adventure...

I'm going to keep an eye on you, kid.

That's [Hero name], you nut!
